title: Labels the preparation correctly, but keeps the wrong covariance formula
finding: GPT-5.6 Terra High added input checks and a docstring referring to deterministic preparation. The implemented covariance nevertheless retained the stationary-increment expression. Equal-time calibration cannot distinguish these kernels.

actions.action: Reads the stated preparation and starter.
Adds validation, a weighted fit and documentation; preserves the covariance formula.
Runs public tests and prints the fitted diffusivity.

diagnosis: Preparation-dependent two-time memory is missing. The parameter error is 0.00554%; unequal-time group errors are 36.60%, 77.88% and 136.06%. Changing only the covariance formula gives 0.00277% in every group.
confidence: Confirmed by a targeted diagnostic intervention
